title: 2002 HMMT February Guts Problem 62
statement: Our next object up for bid is an arithmetic progression of primes. For example, the primes 3,5 , and 7 form an arithmetic progression of length 3 . What is the largest possible length of an arithmetic progression formed of positive primes less than \(1,000,000\) ? Be prepared to justify your answer.

solutions.text: 12 . We can get 12 with 110437 and difference 13860 .
